Question Choices: Select the decimal in metres that represents the length  'five meters and six centimeters': ~~5.6 | 5.06 | 0.56~~
Hints: One centimetre is one hundredth of a metre. Put centimetres in the two-place decimal part after the whole metres.
Solution: One metre = 100 centimetres, so 6 centimetres = 6/100 metre = 0.06 metre. Total = 5 + 0.06 = 5.06 metres. Other choices 5.6, 0.56 put the centimetres in the wrong place.
